reason: My order book is full for months and my wife and the office handle the phone, so a missed call costs me next to nothing. I don't need more requests coming in; I already turn work away.
objection: Why would I pay 99 euros a month to catch callers I couldn't take on anyway? And a brand-new company with two founders and no customers handling my regulars' calls, at my age I don't want to switch things that work.
would_change_my_mind: If my office help retired or left and nobody was there to pick up, the ausgebucht mode that filters to emergencies and regular customers could be worth it, ideally from a company that has been around a few years.
